mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps edging up from its recent trough, weekday foot traffic will recover first and retail-and-recreation mobility will rise over the next four weeks. The mechanism fails if workplace mobility stalls or reverses while retail stays flat or falls.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -42.6 to -38.1 before slipping to -39.3 while RETAIL_REC remained around -35
failure_condition: Reject if WORKPLACES does not rise above the t-0w level within 2 weeks and RETAIL_REC does not become less negative over the following 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains elevated and parks usage turns negative, more discretionary activity shifts indoors and to neighborhood retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC within one week. The signal fails if residential time falls back toward baseline or parks rebounds while retail stays unchanged.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0 after being positive in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from 5.0 to -2.6 while RESIDENTIAL stayed above 8
failure_condition: Reject if PARKS remains at or above 0 and RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to its t-0w level in the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovers only when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve together; a joint easing of commuting frictions expands in-person shopping access and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The mechanism fails if one proxy improves but the other stays flat or worsens.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed near -32 while WORKPLACES improved from -42.6 to -38.1 then softened
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC does not rise over 28 days despite simultaneous week-on-week improvement in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES for at least 2 consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If transit access deteriorates further below the recent -32 level, discretionary shopping trips will be suppressed and RETAIL_REC will fall within two weeks. The claim fails if transit recovers or retail does not weaken after the transit drop.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was already about -32 and retail remained around -35
failure_condition: Reject if TRANSIT drops below -35 but RETAIL_REC is not more negative on average in the next 14 days versus the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained park draw toward zero signals weaker outdoor substitution and more dispersed leisure demand, which reduces the likelihood of a retail upswing over four weeks. The mechanism fails if PARKS rebounds positive without any corresponding decline in retail mobility.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined from 5.0 to -2.6 across the snapshot window
failure_condition: Reject if PARKS turns positive again and RETAIL_REC becomes less negative over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM falls while RESIDENTIAL rises, households are staying home more and concentrating trips into essentials, which will push RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks. The mechanism fails if grocery mobility rebounds or residential time eases and retail does not weaken.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM declines by more than 1 point week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL is at or above 8
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -9.9 to -12.0 while RESIDENTIAL stayed near 8.3-8.7
failure_condition: Reject if GROCERY_PHARM does not remain below its t-0w level and RETAIL_REC is not more negative after 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a continued narrowing of the WORKPLACES deficit will spill into shopping trips with a short lag and lift retail mobility within one week. The mechanism fails in restrictive periods or if workplace mobility stops improving.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -38 after being below -40
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -42.6 to -38.1 before easing to -39.3 while retail stayed near -35
failure_condition: Reject if WORKPLACES crosses above -38 and RETAIL_REC does not increase within the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in TRANSIT and fall in RESIDENTIAL indicates more time spent away from home, and that mix should raise RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The mechanism fails if commuting rises without any reduction in home-stay behavior.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT hovered near -32 while RESIDENTIAL held above 8
failure_condition: Reject if TRANSIT does not improve while RESIDENTIAL stays at or above its t-0w level and RETAIL_REC fails to rise over 28 days.
